coupling: The first commit sizes the temporary transition array for the existing four-range x86 SIMD caller: eight entries accommodate its maximum eight bitmap transitions. The later commit expands that caller to five ranges, which can produce ten transitions, while the helper still passes a ten-entry limit to extract_class_ranges. That function writes past the eight-entry array during public JIT compilation of a five-range character class. Either edit alone remains within the original bound; a correct fix must reconcile the caller limit with the helper capacity across the two commits.
